summary: Route W: a WorldWidgetComponent over the rear plate of the Thorton Galena (player record). A vanilla screen quad is bound to the rear plate and a vanilla .inkwidget holding a text widget is rendered on it; the text is then set at runtime (lab REDscript).

screenMesh.note: 4-vertex two-sided quad in the mesh XZ plane; appearance interactive_screen uses base\materials\screen\screen_ui.mi, the stock world-UI material (default uses screen_advert.mi). Its UVs read correctly from +Y (u grows towards -X), so a yaw of 180 degrees makes it read like the plate's own holo layer (u grows towards +X, seen from -Y).

plate.note: Rear plate of player_01, bound to bumper_b_01. Rectangle of the plate's holo layer (license_plate.mesh chunk 1) in the plate component frame, measured 2026-11-05; the plate's outer face is y = -0.021 and faces -Y (rearwards).

text_sign.name: open77_plate_text
text_sign.note: Root canvas 660x200; StreetName is an inkText whose authored text is 'Example street name'. The library carries the native inkStreetNameSignLogicController, which may write the street name itself.

text_lcd.name: open77_plate_text
text_lcd.note: Root canvas 1500x150; messege_text is an empty inkText driven by the scripted LcdScreenILogicController, which only acts when a device feeds it.

appearances.expect: a lit street-sign panel over the rear plate, text readable from behind the car
the same panel with the quad turned the other way: predicted to read mirrored (orientation control)
a thin LCD strip over the plate, empty until the lab REDscript writes the text
the bare screen quad with no widget: placement control
